summary: Meta's FAISS vector search library published version 1.14.0/1.14.1 release notes listing SIMD optimizations, API additions (IndexBinaryFlat, LeanVec, hadamard IVF index), Python version support updates, and build fixes.

practices.reason: Engineering teams using FAISS could benefit from SIMD-optimized RaBitQ inner product and scalar quantizer dispatch improvements, but no performance figures are given.
New C API exposure and Python version support changes create minor integration work for teams building on FAISS.
practices.quote: Expose IndexBinaryFlat to the C API. (#4834)
